earnings.title: The Hartford Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Third quarter 2026 net income available to common stockholders of $1.3 billion ($4.82 per diluted share) increased 23% from $1.1 billion ($3.77 per diluted share) over the same period in 2025.
Net income ROE for the trailing 12 months of 25.0% and core earnings ROE* of 17.9%.
Employee Benefits third quarter 2026 net income margin of 7.0% and a core earnings margin* of 6.4%.
Increased quarterly common dividend per share by 12%
Returned $638 million to stockholders in the third quarter, including $475 million of shares repurchased and $163 million in common stockholder dividends paid.

quotes.text: The Hartford delivered another quarter of strong results in an increasingly competitive market.
quotes.by: The Hartford's Chairman and CEO Christopher Swift
